# SecondFactor.ai

> One API to send and verify one-time passwords (OTPs) over SMS, WhatsApp, Viber and RCS. SecondFactor generates, delivers and checks the code, routes each send to the lowest-cost eligible channel for the destination and falls back to the next channel automatically. One price per country per OTP sent, whichever channel delivers it. A product of Digital 360 Pte. Ltd., Singapore.

Key facts:
- Two API calls per verification: POST /v2/Services/{ServiceSid}/Verifications to send a code, POST /v2/Services/{ServiceSid}/VerificationCheck to check it. Twilio Verify v2-shaped paths, authenticated with an X-API-Key header.
- Channels: SMS, WhatsApp, Viber, RCS (and Silent Network Authentication where available). WhatsApp, Viber and RCS need sender approval through the respective platform.
- Routing: the Price Intelligence Engine (PIE) picks the cheapest eligible channel per request and fails over if delivery isn't confirmed within eight seconds.
- Pricing: USD per OTP sent, one rate per destination country, delivery and verification included; prepaid credits, no monthly fee. Per-channel pricing on request.
- Accounts: https://app.secondfactor.ai (sign up, API keys, templates, delivery logs). Support: support@secondfactor.ai.

## API and integration

- [API documentation](https://docs.secondfactor.ai): authentication, send, check, fetch a verification, webhooks, errors, SDKs for JavaScript, Node and Python.
- [Full API reference for coding agents](https://api.secondfactor.ai/llms-full.txt): every endpoint, request and response body, error code, rate limit and a step-by-step integration guide. Fetch it with a plain HTTP client; summarising tools drop the limits and status codes.
- [API summary](https://api.secondfactor.ai/llms.txt): short index of the API reference.
- [Docs page on this site](https://secondfactor.ai/docs/): send a code, check it, fetch a verification, webhooks, polling.
- [How to add phone verification to a Node.js app](https://secondfactor.ai/blog/nodejs-phone-verification/): Express walkthrough using the OTP API.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://secondfactor.ai/pricing/): price per OTP sent by destination country, in USD, with a per-country selector.
- [Price list as JSON](https://secondfactor.ai/data/pricing.json): the current published list, one object per country (ISO code, name, price as a six-place USD decimal string, currency). Refreshed automatically from the API.
- [Savings calculator vs Twilio Verify](https://secondfactor.ai/tools/savings-calculator/): compare cost per completed verification for a country and monthly volume.
- [OTP delivery by country](https://secondfactor.ai/country/): directory of country pages with dialing codes, setup guidance and prices.

## Channels

- [Channels overview](https://secondfactor.ai/channels/): how the four channels combine behind one API.
- [SMS OTP](https://secondfactor.ai/channels/sms/): reach any mobile number; sender setup by destination.
- [WhatsApp OTP](https://secondfactor.ai/channels/whatsapp/): authentication templates through a connected WhatsApp Business Account.
- [Viber OTP](https://secondfactor.ai/channels/viber/): approved business sender, supported markets.
- [RCS OTP](https://secondfactor.ai/channels/rcs/): branded verification messages on supported devices and carriers.

## Features

- [Features overview](https://secondfactor.ai/features/)
- [Automatic OTP routing and fallback](https://secondfactor.ai/features/otp-routing-fallback/): cost-based channel selection, eight-second fallback window.
- [Delivery logs and costs](https://secondfactor.ai/features/otp-delivery-logs/): per-request channel, status and cost; delivery and verification webhooks.
- [Template management](https://secondfactor.ai/features/otp-template-management/): templates per channel, approval tracking, default template.
- [PIE Playground](https://secondfactor.ai/features/pie-playground/): send a real OTP with free credits and inspect the chosen route before integrating.

## Free tools

- [Free phone tools](https://secondfactor.ai/tools/): directory.
- [Phone carrier check](https://secondfactor.ai/tools/carrier-check/): carrier, country and calling code for a number.
- [Phone type check](https://secondfactor.ai/tools/phone-type-check/): mobile, landline, VoIP or toll-free.
- [Phone number validation](https://secondfactor.ai/tools/phone-number-validation/): format and numbering-plan check.
